Type.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/6] A risk management process was implemented throughout the project. Participants were monitored for signs of distress during the interviews/focus groups and were identified as "at risk" if they reported (i) a drop in mood after the interview/group discussion, which was assessed using a visual analogue scale where participants self-rated how they were feeling before commencing and again at the close of the interview/focus group11; (ii) high levels of current distress, indicated by scores on the PHQ-9; (iii) experiencing suicidal thoughts in the previous 2 weeks, indicated by a score of more than 0 on item 9 of the PHQ-9; or (iv) distress during participation.
